description: RQ-2 state-confound quantification (06 v1.1 issue 9 item 7; §2 RQ-2): a state-only classifier on patient-level IED status, patient-grouped on the frozen manifest. Run plan F approved by Josue 2026-10-17. Descriptive; feeds the evaluation-validity chapter; does not touch RESULT-001.
unit: recording (= patient), the 69 primary recordings; target = IED-positive (groups E and N, 42) vs IED-free (group F, 27)

state_label: sleep_share: share of the recording's kept epochs annotated sleep (06 §4.2 primary set; mixed/unlabelled already excluded)
state_label_plus_proxies: mean relative delta power (B1 rel_delta, mean over channels and kept epochs)
mean relative sigma power (B1 rel_sigma, same)
features.source: the EXP-004 feature cache data/interim/features/salience2s (labels never enter the features)

learner: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter 5000) after StandardScaler fitted on the training recordings; unweighted; no tuning (69 recordings)
evaluation: for each of the 10 frozen repeats, the 5 outer folds of the F-3 manifest (primary set): fit on 4 folds, predict the held-out recordings; per repeat the AUROC over all 69 held-out predictions; reported as the mean over repeats with the repeat range
interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over recordings (10,000 resamples, seed 20261010) of the AUROC of the repeat-averaged held-out probabilities
reading: descriptive: an AUROC near 0.5 means state composition and state proxies carry little patient-level IED information on vEpiSet; a high AUROC quantifies a patient-level state confound that epoch-pooled or patient-level evaluations would inherit. The within-patient same-state primary estimand is not affected either way.
